speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are a pregnant patient presenting with fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help narrow down the cause, have you experienced any muscle aches, rash, or difficulty breathing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Given your pregnancy, sudden onset of fever, headache, and anorexia, along with ice cream consumption, could you tell me if you have noticed any specific rash, vision changes, or if you have had similar symptoms in the past? Also, has anyone in your household been sick recently?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, Liver_Function_Tests, IgM/IgG_Serology

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: WBC: 15,000 /μL (elevated); Hemoglobin: 12.5 g/dL; Platelets: 200,000 /μL; Liver_Function_Tests: AST Within normal limits, ALT Within normal limits, Bilirubin Within normal limits; CRP: NORMAL READINGS; IgM/IgG_Serology: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis)

While your previous doctor suggested iron deficiency anemia, the combination of sudden high fever, severe headache, and anorexia shortly after eating dairy products (ice cream) during pregnancy is highly suggestive of Listeriosis. Iron deficiency anemia does not typically cause sudden fever and anorexia in this manner. I will need to review the results of the CBC, Liver Function Tests, and specific IgM/IgG serology to confirm the presence of infection and rule out other causes like viral hepatitis or flu.
